mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_config (id, config_key, config_value, env, active, version, remark, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{env}, #{active}, #{version}, #{remark}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_config WHERE config_key = #{configKey} AND env = #{env} AND active = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM ai_config WHERE config_key = #{configKey} AND env = #{env}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_config SET active = 0 WHERE config_key = #{configKey} AND env = #{env} AND active = 1
